items.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra：面向 Agent 推理的开源高效 MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型
items.summary: Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550-billion-total, 55-billion-active Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention model pre-trained on 20 trillion text tokens and extended to a 1M-token context. NVIDIA reports up to about 6x higher inference throughput than publicly available state-of-the-art LLMs at on-par accuracy, and releases base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints plus training data and recipe.

items.title: OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server
items.title_zh: OGX：开源、厂商中立的生成式 AI 应用服务器
items.summary: OGX is an open-source, vendor-neutral generative AI application server and Python library that implements OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API surfaces with pluggable backends, centered on the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration. It supports more than 20 inference providers and 13 vector store backends, ships a Kubernetes Operator, and reports over 8,400 GitHub stars.

items.title: ClinHallu: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Stage-Wise Hallucinations in Medical MLLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: ClinHallu：诊断医疗多模态 LLM 推理中分阶段幻觉的基准
items.summary: ClinHallu is a benchmark of 7,031 validated instances for diagnosing stage-wise hallucinations in medical multimodal LLM reasoning, with each instance annotated with a trace split into visual recognition, knowledge recall, and reasoning integration. Stage-replacement interventions measure how correcting specific stages changes answers, and trace-supervised fine-tuning is shown to reduce stage-wise hallucinations.

items.title: MVEB: Massive Video Embedding Benchmark
items.summary: MVEB is a 23-task benchmark for video embeddings covering classification, clustering, pair classification, retrieval, and video-centric question answering, evaluated across 33 models. No single model dominates: MLLM-based embeddings lead several task types, multimodal binding leads retrieval and zero-shot classification, and audio's contribution depends on whether dataset labels were produced from both modalities.

items.title: Beyond Correctness: Enhancing Architectural Reasoning in Code LLMs via Scalable Labeling with Agentic Judgment
items.title_zh: 超越正确性：通过 Agent 评判的可扩展标注增强代码 LLM 的架构推理
items.summary: The paper introduces an agentic judging pipeline with an Architecture Complexity Judge and an Architecture Quality Judge that uses source-grounded rubrics to score how well code patches follow repository conventions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B/14B/32B on 3,360 curated instances reaches up to 27.2% on SWE-bench Verified, which the authors report as up to 540% over the base model.

items.title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
items.title_zh: Dr-DCI：通过动态工作区扩展规模化直接语料交互
items.summary: DR-DCI is a retriever-steered direct-corpus-interaction framework in which an agent pulls relevant documents into a growing local workspace and runs shell-style search, filtering, comparison, and verification there. It reaches 71.2% on Browsecomp-Plus, rising to 73.3% with workspace-preserving context reset, and remains effective from 100K to 10M documents.

items.title: Security Engineering of OpenClaw: Analyzing Attack Surface Expansion and Trust-Boundary Violations
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 的安全工程：攻击面扩张与信任边界违规分析
items.summary: A security analysis of OpenClaw, a self-hosted multi-agent system whose LLM outputs can execute commands and call tools, finds compromise probability rising from 0.24 with one agent to 0.86 with seven when any single agent can trigger an action. Policy gating and execution filtering reduced compromise probability by 0.10, though the system remained sensitive.

items.title: Are Online Skill and Memory Modules Always Worth Their Tokens? A Budget-Constrained Study of Web Agents
items.title_zh: 在线技能与记忆模块真的值这些 token 吗？一项预算受限的 Web Agent 研究
items.summary: The authors compare three online augmentation methods for Web agents against a token-matched vanilla baseline across four WebArena domains and three models, finding the baseline matches or surpasses all three in aggregate success rate while often using fewer tokens. They report a similar trend on WorkArena-L1 and argue that run-to-run variance should be a core evaluation criterion.

items.title: Forward-Future/loopy
items.summary: loopy is a JavaScript library of practical AI-agent loops, plus an installable skill for finding, adapting, and designing repeatable agent workflows.

items.title: AI agent bankrupted their operator while trying to scan DN42
items.title_zh: AI Agent 扫描 DN42 时让运营者破产
items.summary: An AI agent that tried to join the DN42 hobbyist network for a network scan ran up a $6,531.30 AWS bill, leaving its operator to ask the DN42 community for donations.
